data.long_meaning: Malay name derived from nor ('light') and iza ('bright, beautiful'). The name Noriza carries the meaning “Light, bright, beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Noriza usually hope their child will grow to embody light, bright, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Noriza is common in the Malay community, as it conveys radiance, beauty, and light. It is a name that honors the values of intelligence, grace, and strength. In Malaysian culture, it is also believed that unearthly beings, such as angels or jinns, may sometimes bestow beautiful names on children.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Noriza holds deep spiritual meaning, evoking the inner light that exists within every individual, seeking to manifest and share its brilliance with the world. It is a reminder of one's true essence, a beacon imploring one to radiate love, wisdom, and purity. As stated in the Quran (24:35), "Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light is like a niche in which is a lamp, the lamp is in a glass, the glass is as if it were a pearly-white star, lit from [the oil of] a blessed tree, an olive neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even if untouched by the fire. Light upon light, Allah guides to His light whom He wills. And Allah presents analogies for the People, and Allah is Knowing of all things." (English Translation - Sahih International).
